newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan exporters optimistic of future - poll.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan exporters optimistic of future - poll.

text.p: Sri Lankan exporters are optimistic that improved product quality, marketing and economic conditions will boost exports in the coming years, the state-owned Daily News said on Tuesday.

The newspaper said that over 50 percent of 77 Sri Lankan exporters, surveyed by the Gallup Organisation as part of its DHL Export Indicator poll in 15 Asia Pacific countries, said that prospects were "excellent" or "good" for the next 12 months compared to the previous 12 months.
This trend will continue for the next five years, the newspaper quoted the poll as saying.
Sri Lankan exporters saw Europe, the United States and the Middle East as the largest growing export markets over the next 12 months.

Sri Lanka's exports rose by 13 percent in 1996 despite a poor performance by the manufacturing sector. The Asian Development Bank has forecast Sri Lanka's exports will grow by 17 percent to $4.97 billion this year and rise to above $5 billion in 1998.
